intendedUse: Owner-selected main playable character for Tervain 0.0.8.

source.workshop: Original source, editable Blender scene, texture sources, prompts and validation remain in the owner’s approved wanderer-hero-50k asset workshop. They are not bundled in the game.
source.history: Owner-supplied Meshy model, UV-preserving reduction to 49,500 triangles, original rig and five clips, owner-authorized ImageGen material refinement. No Gothic/Warcraft game files are shipped.

terms.authority: Owner explicitly approved the finished hero and requested adding him as Tervain’s main character on 2026-10-02.
terms.credit: The Weathered Wanderer — supplied by Ael; Meshy-generated source, refined and rigged for Tervain using Blender and owner-authorized ImageGen textures.
terms.boundary: Specific project-use authority. No general open-content license, exclusive authorship or independently reviewed Meshy/account/third-party rights are asserted.

runtime.loading: Locally served embedded GLB using the existing Three.js GLTFLoader; use import.meta.env.BASE_URL so GitHub Pages subpaths work.

clips.name: WalkRootMotion
clips.gameplayUse: Preserved for authoring; do not loop this alongside controller movement.

metallicRoughness.channels: G roughness, B metallic; R unused by the material.

materials.compressedTextureFormat: Lossless WebP is a download encoding, not GPU block compression.
materials.estimateBoundary: Three maps decoded as RGBA8 with a full mip chain; device residency and render performance are not measured by this estimate.

preparation.operation: Lossless encoding only: no resize, repaint, palette, normal, UV, geometry, weight, rig or animation changes.

motionPolicy.rootMotion: Keep the gameplay controller authoritative. Use Walk for controller-driven locomotion; WalkRootMotion is preserved but cannot be layered on top of controller translation.
motionPolicy.contacts: Source rig/deformation audits verify the authored walk. Controller speed, slopes, weapons and camera contact must be checked in the integrated game.

verification.assetPreparation: Passed: approved source hash; exact decoded pixels for all three maps; byte-identical non-image buffer views; identical scene/mesh/skin/animation/material semantics; strict triangle budget and complete clip contract.
verification.gameIntegration: Requires integrated typecheck/tests/build and running-game observations; not implied by asset preparation.
verification.publication: No remote publication or CI was performed by this preparation script.

currentRuntime.note: The game plays a new body for the same character; the record above describes the A37 model, retained for audit.

source.generatedBy: Ael's account under Meshy Pro, 9 October 2026
source.inputs: Front, side and back renders of the previous wanderer (the A69 sealed model) in his bind pose

rig.unchanged: nodes, joint names, hierarchy, inverse bind matrices and clips

preparation.tool: node tools/hero/rework-hero.mjs <hero-01a120c8.glb>, then node tools/hero/record.mjs; deterministic
preparation.alignment: Scale 0.99989 to 1.899 m, soles at world y 0, facing +z as delivered, slid 1.4 mm x / 3.5 mm z onto the previous body; surface gap to the previous body median 8.5 mm, 95th percentile 26.8 mm
preparation.jointFit: Upper-arm cross-sections centre within 13 mm of the bones (previous body 9 mm); forearm and wrist sections 35-38 mm off the bone line (previous body 12-26 mm); the arm line differs from the previous body by about 4.5 degrees
preparation.simplification: MeshoptSimplifier.simplifyWithAttributes, normals weighted 0.5, seams locked; 435,562 -> 150,000 triangles, error 0.024% of the extent (0.5 mm); 13 back-to-back folded pairs dropped -> 149,974
preparation.skinning: Closest point on the A45 skinned surface in bind pose (faces turned away count from 3 cm further), barycentric interpolation of its corner weights, copies of one position share one set, two smoothing passes (0.3); hands from their finger chains by band across the hand and depth down it, the thumb as the piece that parts from the hand with its ball and metacarpal on Thumb1 (A73: depth along the thumb mapped from the start of its ball, 60 mm heel and 40 mm thumb knuckle blends), 14 mm finger knuckle blends, then 20 further smoothing passes (0.5) over both hands; skull held on the Head joint; four influences; dual-quaternion skinning at runtime

currentRuntime.verification: tsc, vitest and build pass; checked in the running game at Rillford (idle, close front, face, walking, running, sword drawn and attacking, bow drawn). Close up, a sword grip shows small creases and dark flecks between the fused fingers.
